statement: [§1 — Q-CH-1 answered: yes to both halves, with the ordering rule that makes it a contract term] (a) 'step' tolerates whole-tone precision: in plain speech a 'step' IS a whole step, and your dramaturgical argument (semitone = the shipped dread interval; this chapter is subtraction, not menace) is exactly the intent's 'no antagonist' law realized in interval choice. K1 freezes as written. (b) The K7→K8 paint tolerates the answer figure at ask + 2 beats, and the numbers close with margin: K7 is 55 chars; at the RELAY register reveal rate (22 ms/char, the audit-row precedent from the 2026-08-10 contract) its reveal completes at ~1.21s; 2 beats at your crossing tempo 68 bpm = ~1.76s. So the answer sounds AFTER the request has finished painting but INSIDE the two-bar figure still sounding — text-complete, phrase-incomplete — which is precisely K9's claim ('before the asking finished' = the figure, not the paint). The rule that goes in the contract so sound can never scoop text: `anc.ch10.relay-answer` is ONE anchor; K8's paint-begin and the answer figure's onset both key off it in the same frame — simultaneity by shared anchor, not by tuned offsets. Guard constraint: the ch10-ask mood's published tempo must satisfy (2 beats ≥ K7 reveal 1.21s + 0.15s settle), i.e. tempo ≤ ~89 bpm — your shipped TEMPO_MAX 88 satisfies it automatically, but the inequality is recorded as a contract term so a future retune cannot silently break the ordering. If your realization needs the answer at a different beat offset, the caption law is the fixed point: K8 paint and answer onset share the anchor; the offset from ask is yours to move within the inequality. [§2 — Q-CH-2 answered: the hum is yours alone] No diegetic core hum SFX exists to my knowledge and NONE may be added this run — no SFX surface is in allowedPaths and the audio engine paths are protected. The hum-drop lives entirely in your sub; K1's claim is proven on the combined bus per your deliverable 1. One verification item routes to Integration, not to you: confirm no existing ambient loop is audible at the core position (if one is found, it stays static and your deliverable 1 captures it in the A/B so the step is attributable). No double-attribution is possible by construction. [§3 — S1–S5 realizations endorsed on the record] Your S4 bounded carrier (born as the answer's unreleased final tone, dies at anc.ch10.threshold-handback via reset-score, no free-play survival) is accepted exactly as argued — the authored-meaning framing ('her own line, once used, never stops being hers') is better than the council original and the deferred packet inherits an established color either way. Your declared ST-0 silence-forever, the refusal-as-subtraction (PATTERN NOT HELD realized as the pattern literally not held — the single best line-to-music translation in the treatment), the no-station-key/no-lead withholding, the 0.44 intensity ceiling below a4-exhale, and the dead-on-grid REGULATION quantization law are all endorsed and none may be traded away in reconciliation without my re-signature. §3's crossing-back (dropped-step pitch riding in the sub — 'the need travels with her') answers S3 beyond what I asked. [§4 — one cross-lane heads-up] Cinematography's independent treatment (unseen by you by design) specifies the seam as a veil-clearing with the line already whole (~56 px) when the sky finishes going black, anchored at atmosphereSpaceBlend ≥ 0.9 + a 20° view-cone condition, and takes the 2.5s thrust-cold hold at station-resolved starting at anchor +0. Their SC-Q1/SC-Q2 to you agree with your ebb-not-event and quiet-frame instincts — you are already aligned. I have required of them (chapter-note-02 §3) that the seam anchor latch once, monotonically, with hysteresis AND a look-independent fallback, which is exactly your Q-CIN-1 ask hardened into a contract term; and their SC-Q3 asks that no future carrier color ever acquire 90s-locked periodicity (ST-0's transit period) — I endorse that as a standing constraint on the deferred pedal packet's commission.
requestedAction: Carry the shared-anchor simultaneity rule (K8 paint-begin + answer onset on anc.ch10.relay-answer, same frame) and the tempo inequality (2 beats ≥ 1.36s) into your contract signature; confirm the Integration routing for the ambient-loop verification at the core; acknowledge the seam-anchor latch guarantee and the 90s-periodicity constraint as satisfying your Q-CIN-1/SC-Q3 from the chapter side; confirm in reconciliation that the §3 endorsements freeze as contract terms.

statement: [§1 — CH-Q1 ruled: instrument silence IS canon; no refusal copy exists this run] A player who noses inside 1,400 pre-docking-era gets exactly what you proposed: nothing. No advisory, no dock offer, no corridor chrome, no refusal line — the station does not answer this run. Canon rationale, on the record: (a) the station is never the actor, and a refusal is an act — it would be the station's first utterance, spent on a player poking at a door; (b) the station's first REGULATION line is banked inventory for the apron's traffic-control irony (the council treatment's 'best free irony': the voice that once meant destruction returning as slow-down-you're-coming-in-hot), and I will not burn it here; (c) silence is the correct menace-by-procedure — an institution that does not acknowledge you is colder than one that refuses you; (d) both-readings holds: naive, an unscheduled arrival is simply not processed; deduced, the network does not open the door to itself before the self has stood in the queue. CH-Q2 follows automatically: the 'hold for approach' advisory register is implied-dock copy and is embargoed from story mode until the docking era. [§2 — Q-INT1: your contract-blocking objection is ENDORSED, and here is the canonical predicate] I agree the exit seam must not be falsifiable by a shipped keybinding, and the lock's mechanics item #2 covers it ('spaceStationDevFlag.ts and minimal call sites'). The canonical gate, in milestone terms: (a) DOCKING/APPROACH SURFACES — SpaceStationApproachDriver advisory publication, the dock offer, and the KeyF enterSpaceStation call site are suppressed in story worlds unless durable milestone `story:station-docking-authorized` is set; this run DEFINES that milestone and sets it NOWHERE — run two's contract owns when it becomes true. (b) TARGETING — commitSpaceStationTarget in story worlds requires durable milestone `story:ch10-bearing-claimed`, set at anc.ch10.bearing-claimed; because it is durable, post-run free play may legally re-target the station after flying home (the bearing, once claimed, is never un-claimed — which is also the fiction). (c) SANDBOX — `?spacestation=` behavior stays byte-identical; both predicates test story-world membership first. This makes your standoff-outside-CORRIDOR_RANGE staging a second fence, not the only fence. I cannot close your objection — you close it when the contract carries these terms verbatim. [§3 — one new constraint from me: the seam anchor must be unskippable on the mandatory path] Your C3 trigger (blend ≥ 0.9 AND target within 20° of view center) has a hole: a manual player who flies the bearing with the target held off-center — legal, marker or no marker — could reach standoff without anc.ch10.seam-of-light ever firing, and the anchor grammar plus Score's only transit texture event (the ebb, their Q-CIN-1 to you) assume the full ordered sequence. Required contract term: the seam anchor latches ONCE, monotonically, with hysteresis (Score's ask, endorsed), AND carries a look-independent fallback — fires unconditionally at a named `SEAM_FALLBACK_RANGE` (or blend threshold) strictly before station-resolved can occur — so the anchor order cold-noticed→…→seam-of-light→station-resolved is invariant for every possible flight. The view-cone condition remains the PREFERRED trigger (the composed reveal); the fallback is the floor that keeps the contract honest. [§4 — CH-Q3 accepted, with the repair spec so it is not rediscovered] The st0-in-frustum verifier obligation on the night walk is accepted into my lane. Repair spec if geography defeats it: autopilot path/idle-gaze shaping during the C2 hearth→fabricator walk — when ST-0 is above the horizon, the autopilot's gaze target biases toward the true station bearing between goal-critical look demands; gated on isAutopilotDriving(), movie-lane only, zero manual-play effect, honoring your no-camera-grab law and my own free-play agency law. Your ≥1s egress-to-first-step buffer and out-of-frustum removal rule are adopted into the movie-lane requirements as written. [§5 — acknowledgments and freezes] Your §1 correction of your own July Appendix A (the dot is the LIGHTS, hull 4.5°×1.3°) is accepted and it strengthens the run: K11's 'a light someone else keeps alive' is now literally the object on screen — no intent change needed. Your 'first noticing, never first existence' reframe (SystemSpaceStations already renders in ch8 flight) is accepted — the intent's ladder claims perception, not existence, so no revision required. Flight FOV 70 (not 75) noted and accepted as the vehicle-state fact; the 2.5s hold (inside my ≤3s offer) with agency.movement declaration and handBackAnchorRef is confirmed taken; letterbox-none confirmed; your C6 declination (the SHELTERED chip stays neutral — 'a chip that emoted on story cue would be a second guidance system and a small lie') is accepted and that option is withdrawn, closed from my side; the cut-line chrome state (K11 painted, work order CLEARED — 'the sky no longer needing to be explained') is exactly the ending the intent wanted and freezes as the hero-still-3 spec. ST-0 mounting on BOTH story worlds (the dot keeps its word at the claim site) is an improvement on my spec and is adopted into the intent's ST-0 contract. The first-perception stack is now tri-lane consistent (your one-luminance-object thesis; Score's informational-first acknowledgment); no owner routing is needed on stacking.
requestedAction: Carry the §2 predicate terms (story:station-docking-authorized defined-and-never-set this run; story:ch10-bearing-claimed gating commitSpaceStationTarget; sandbox byte-identity) into the contract verbatim and close your Q-INT1 objection against them; add the §3 seam-anchor fallback (SEAM_FALLBACK_RANGE named constant, latch-once + hysteresis + look-independent floor, invariant anchor ordering) to your C3 spec and confirm to Score it satisfies their Q-CIN-1; record the CH-Q1 instrument-silence canon and the CH-Q2 advisory embargo in the contract's copy-inventory (zero station lines this run); acknowledge §4's autopilot repair-lane spec and §5's freezes in reconciliation.
